evidence.text: About Us - El Calamar Restaurant Skip to content Home About Us Contact Menu Order Online Reservations Order Now Order Now Reservations Home About Us Contact Menu Order Online Reservations Order Now Order Now About Us. Authentic Mariscos Since 2007 We really believe that great seafood starts with respecting the ingredients. That is why we still hand-pick our catch and make every single salsa and marinade from scratch every day. For us, El Calamar is more than just a business. It is a place where families come to celebrate and friends catch up over a few cold drinks. We love seeing our community come together over a great meal, and we are proud to be a part of your Friday nights and weekend tradition. Restaurant Amenities Free WiFi Family Friendly Live Music Parking "I have always believed that you can taste the difference when food is made with heart. From the fresh catch we bring in to the salsas we prep every morning, we do not take shortcuts. My goal has always been simple: to give our neighbors the most authentic and fresh mariscos experience possible." - Hugo Camacho Book your reservation online or give us a call.
